title: Bob Lazar walks underneath the craft

tellings.quote: but but but what what happened when the Bob Bazar case where he walks underneath the craft?

plain: In 1989 a man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked on recovered craft at a secret Nevada site called S-4, is said to have walked underneath one of those craft. Michels raises it only as a question to his guest Grant Cameron, asking what happened in the Lazar case "where he walks underneath the craft", and he gives no further detail. If true, it would mean a person had stood beneath a machine that was not built by people.
